Generate a flexible block grid with left-to-right traversal

Source: R/func_generate_grid_Dan.R
generate.grid.lr.Rd

Iteratively computes block indices using a strict left-to-right traversal order across all rows. Handles cases where block dimensions do not evenly divide file dimensions by allowing the last block in each row or column to be smaller.

Usage

generate.grid.lr(fnrow, fncol, bnrow, bncol)

Arguments

fnrow

Integer. Number of rows in the file or matrix.

fncol

Integer. Number of columns in the file or matrix.

bnrow

Integer. Number of rows per block.

bncol

Integer. Number of columns per block.

Value

A data.frame with columns block_no, U, D, L, R. See generate_grid for column descriptions.

See also

generate_grid, generate.grid.exact, generate.grid.rowsnake

Examples

# Last block row and column are smaller; every block row runs left to right
generate.grid.lr(5, 7, 2, 3)
#>   block_no U D L R
#> 1        1 1 2 1 3
#> 2        2 1 2 4 6
#> 3        3 1 2 7 7
#> 4        4 3 4 1 3
#> 5        5 3 4 4 6
#> 6        6 3 4 7 7
#> 7        7 5 5 1 3
#> 8        8 5 5 4 6
#> 9        9 5 5 7 7
